description: Building damage assessment of Adassil, Morocco after 2023 Marrakesh–Safi earthquake is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. The dataset contains shapefile of damaged and non damaged buildings of Adassil town, Chichaoua Province of the Marrakesh-Safi region of Morocco. The dataset has been created using openly available google buildings dataset, humanitarian open street data, MAXAR satellite data and segment-geospatial package. Coverage: Morocco. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. Its tags are MoroccoEarthquake. The repository dates the deposit 2023; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
